# EvilRed

EvilRed gives Obsidian a red-on-dark interface with high-contrast accents across its elements. The recorded description states compatibility with Obsidian v1.4.13 and above, and the theme index lists dark mode only.

![EvilRed screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tu2-atmanand/EvilRed-ObsidianTheme/HEAD/Thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "EvilRed"
    author: "Atmanand Gauns"
    repo:   "tu2-atmanand/EvilRed-ObsidianTheme"
    slug:   "evilred"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/evilred"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/tu2-atmanand/EvilRed-ObsidianTheme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tu2-atmanand/EvilRed-ObsidianTheme/HEAD/Thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply the EvilRed dark-red theme to give Obsidian a consistent red-on-dark interface with high-contrast accents and readable UI elements. Maintain compatibility with Obsidian v1.4.13 and above."
}
```
